text_blocks.snippet: Gastrointestinal (GI) symptoms can be associated with COVID-19, either as early signs of infection or as part of long COVID. These symptoms can include upset stomach, diarrhea, and vomiting, and can sometimes be mistaken for stomach flu (gastroenteritis). While GI symptoms are not the most common, they can be significant for some individuals.
